title: How ‘Psychopath’ Trump’s Mayhem Will Backfire in 2028 for Republicans
author: John Harwood
content:
Donald Trump seems to think he can run for president in 2028, and [if the law
still stands](https://zeteo.com/p/how-trump-is-turning-the-us-intel), _he can
't_ - but the seat may go to one of his top sycophants.

That's why Marco Rubio, Ted Cruz, JD Vance, and Doug Burgum don't push back on
Trump's reign of terror, argues political scientist **Norm Ornstein** , as he
joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood** to unpack just how the Republican party got to
this level of cult-dom.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

But as [prices soar](https://www.forbes.com/sites/mattrandolph/2026/08/14/gas-
and-diesel-prices-on-track-for-their-most-expensive-august-ever/) and people
can't afford [healthcare](https://news.gallup.com/poll/710942/adults-ability-
afford-healthcare-five-year-low.aspx), is associating with the [failing
president](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-no-way-out) a good idea?

This was a **Substack live** conversation, where **Zeteo** subscribers could
ask questions in real time. Watch the **full video above** to hear what
Ornstein thinks will come after Trump, how the president threatens his
colleagues, and why __ Ornstein believes that Newt Gingrich and Mitch
McConnell _(wherever he is!)_ are as much to blame as Trump _._
